name: Hana no Ooero Inmutan
source:
R-18 boys love novel set in Ero Period (pun of Edo period). 
A short story with a single path. Blood and tears are shed. Serious, with few humorous scenes. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095357.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
R-18男孩喜欢以Ero时代（江户时代的双关语）为背景的小说。
一个单一路径的短篇故事。血和泪都流出来了。严肃，幽默的场面很少。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095357.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
